title: 有界解析与分片策略
commands: cargo xtask build-ebpf  # build-node (arm64), object is arch-independent
cargo build --bin cloud-node-rust  # x86-build, embeds eBPF object
cargo check --lib  # macOS, no new warnings

results.verifier: all programs loaded, no rejection, no out-of-bounds

classification_contract.UNSUPPORTED: legal but unparseable; PASS; counters unsupported+pass
classification_contract.FRAGMENTED: any IP fragment incl first/atomic; policy pass|drop; counters fragmented+pass/drop; no L4 state created

known_limitations: fragment_action defaults to pass; per-service drop policy is EN-06/07 scope
IPv6 ext-chain beyond depth limit classifies UNSUPPORTED (PASS), not DROP
kernel 6.1 native-attach verifier acceptance not exercised (env is 7.0.14 skb)
